scientific.integrity: The universal part of the claim combines an exact symbolic difference-body construction with the materially inspected published common-vertex equal-length theorem. Exact arithmetic is used for all algebraic identities; no numerical sampling is used as proof.
limitations: The theorem is vertex-anchored and does not determine the global boundary six-point optimum.
It does not prove the conjectural extremality of the regular pentagon among all convex bodies.
Historical novelty retains a residual indexing risk for unpublished or unindexed exact calculations behind the 2004 approximate figure.
